platform: KEXP Seattle Digital Rotation Consideration Email Route
manual_review_reason: KEXP requires a carefully prepared email to md@kexp.org with streaming and downloadable WAV links, artist and pronoun information, release metadata, phonetic spellings, focus tracks, release dates, clean edits where needed, lyrics, credits, biography or one-sheet and relevant show dates. Attachments and physical submissions are not accepted, so a human must prepare and verify the complete link-based package.

platform: WREK 91.1 Atlanta Email and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WREK's current music page links to its official legacy submission instructions, which publish music.director@wrek.org and a physical route, state that common formats are accepted and indicate that CDs and LPs may receive more operator attention. A human must choose the delivery method, prepare the release and resolve the current-versus-legacy street-address discrepancy before any physical shipment.

platform: WTUL 91.5 New Orleans Protected Music-Director Email and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WTUL directs physical submissions to its published mailing address and digital submissions to the appropriate music director on a staff page where addresses are JavaScript-protected. The same contact page also contains a CAPTCHA-protected general form. A human must select the correct Head, Assistant or International/World Music Director, use the authorized visible interface without automated decoding, and prepare the release package or physical shipment.

platform: WUOG 90.5 Athens Physical Album Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WUOG explicitly asks artists seeking airtime consideration to mail an album in the appropriate format to its Music Directors. A human must confirm the accepted format, prepare the physical media and release information, address the package correctly and understand that the separately published director emails are contacts rather than an authorization to substitute an email submission.

platform: WKDU 91.7 Philadelphia Music Submission Contact Form Route
manual_review_reason: WKDU provides a public contact form with a dedicated Music Submission topic and required name, email, subject and message fields, but publishes no detailed audio-link, file-format or metadata requirements on that page. A human must inspect the live form, select the correct topic, prepare a concise rights-cleared inquiry or pitch and avoid supplying files or links that the station has not authorized.
